args.text: Can you pull together every site on Marrow Agrisupply you can find across #central-team? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.

Hi Pree, here's every Marrow Agrisupply site I could find in #central-team:

1. *Eastbank*: Hollis, 2026-06-09 10:46 AM. Ticket PD-4821 has the Eastbank receiving-door import attached. The file labels the doors E1/E2 but their booking sheet uses 01/02, so that needs fixing before anyone reimports, or there will be duplicates.
2. *Pine Crossing*: you, 2026-06-09 10:48 AM. The morning receiver's appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift. A driver arrived at 7:10 and they wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce it.
3. *Wichita store* (not certain): you, 2025-07-02 9:21 AM. You mentioned an 8am check-in with the Wichita store dispatcher, right after Tobias said your Zoom was hosting the Marrow Agrisupply office hours link. Nobody actually says Wichita is a Marrow site, so please confirm.

What I left out:
• The Tulsa hub (2025-07-02) is Tansley Parcel.
• Door 6 / #88412 is Tansleigh Packaging.
• Hollis's 2026-06-09 message says three rows on Marrow's rollout tracker just read "waiting", but those stores aren't named in the channel. If the store ops calls gave you the names, they'd be wherever you sent them to Hollis, not in #central-team.
